name: docugit
description: Git-based version control for Office OpenXML documents

scripts.build: bun run embed-templates && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --outfile dist/docugit
scripts.build:windows: bun run prepare-windows-icon && bun run embed-templates && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-icon=assets/icon.ico --outfile dist/docugit.exe
scripts.desktop:dev: cd desktop && bun install && bun run dev
scripts.desktop:build: cd desktop && bun install && bun run build
scripts.desktop:pack: cd desktop && bun install && bun run pack
